create_Aggregator: create an Aggregator model with alternating frame and global attention for multi-frame image processing
build_patch_embed: build a patch embedding layer using conv or dinov2 vision transformer for image tokenization
run_forward: run the Aggregator forward pass on input images and return cached layer outputs
process_frame_attention: process frame-level attention blocks with rotary position embeddings and gradient checkpointing
slice_expand_and_flatten: slice expand and flatten camera and register tokens for multi-frame batch processing
